title: BCAB 2005 - Provision of water supply for firefighting

facts.text: The project is the design and construction of an addition to an existing building supply and garden centre store. The addition will be constructed in two phases and, when complete, the building will be approximately 1 400 m2 in building area, two storeys, unsprinklered, and regulated by Part 3.

An adequate water supply for firefighting is required. Supply options include a water-shuttle operation by the local fire department from a hydrant located 1.2 km away from the property, or enlargement of a “swamp” located on the property to provide a fire water storage pond equipped with a dry hydrant.
